mgmt_bio.text: C.C. Wei has served as chief executive of TSMC since his appointment in 2018, having previously been president and co-CEO from 2013 and co-COO the year before that. He joined TSMC in 1998 and rose through senior technical and commercial roles, leading business development from 2009 to 2012 after serving as president of mainstream technology. Before TSMC, he held senior positions at Chartered Semiconductor and ST Microelectronics, and earlier was a member of the technical staff in the R&D organization at Texas Instruments. In 2025 he received the Semiconductor Industry Association's Robert N. Noyce Award, the semiconductor industry's highest honor, and he leads a management team known for an engineering-first culture and near flawless execution at massive scale.
